caseName: Synnott v. Tombstone Consolidated Mines Co.
caseNameFull: Thomas W. Synnott, etc. v. The Tombstone Consolidated Mines Company, Limited, etc.
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Amos L. Taylor for the appellant. Mr. Aldis B. Browne, Mr. Alexander Britton, Mr. Evans Browne, Mr. Everett E. Ellinwood and Mr. John Mason Ross for the appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon authority of: 1. Coder v. Arts, 213 U. S. 223, 234-235; Tefft, Weller & Co. v. Munsuri, 222 U. S. 114, 118; 2. Chapman v. Bowen, 207 U. S. 89, 91; Calnan Co. v. Doherty, 224 U. S. 145, 147; 3. Conboy v. First National Bank of Jersey City, 203 U. S. 141, 144-145.
